Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq rises while S&P, Dow dip as softer inflation cools Fed hike bets
Markets.summary: US stocks had mixed results on Wednesday after softer inflation data cooled expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. While the Nasdaq rose slightly, the Dow and S&P 500 declined despite both indexes posting quarterly gains.

Markets.title: France’s 10-year bond yield heads for biggest quarterly surge since 1987
Markets.summary: France's 10-year bond yield is heading for its biggest quarterly surge since 1987 due to inflation concerns and rising energy costs. Additionally, the French government plans to issue €340 billion in bonds next year, further straining its fiscal position.

Markets.title: Polymarket introduces deposit limits, lock-outs to combat trading addiction
Markets.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket has introduced new features, including deposit limits and self-imposed lock-outs, to help users control excessive trading habits. The startup is also collaborating with Birches Health to provide mental health support resources for users seeking help.

Markets.title: Indian rupee rebounds to 95.83 vs US dollar as crude prices ease
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened 0.16% to 95.83 against the US dollar. This recovery was driven by falling crude oil prices, dollar selling by public sector banks, and gains in broader Asian currencies.

Markets.title: US SEC proposes wider retail investor access to private assets amid risk concerns
Markets.summary: The US SEC proposed rules to let more everyday professionals qualify as accredited investors, expanding their access to private assets. Critics warn this change could expose retail investors to significant risks and fees.

Markets.title: ElevenLabs' valuation doubles to $22 billion on surging AI voice-agent demand
Markets.summary: AI voice technology company ElevenLabs completed an employee tender offer that doubled its valuation to $22 billion. Investors including Wellington, T. Rowe Price, and Andreessen Horowitz participated in the round as the firm's technology powers over 15 million weekly conversations.

Geo-Political.title: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
Geo-Political.summary: A Flydubai pilot was arrested and questioned after allegedly stabbing another pilot. The incident occurred during a flight to Israel, according to officials.

Geo-Political.title: Six smugglers jailed for manslaughter over worst Channel small boats disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Six human smugglers were convicted of manslaughter after a migrant boat sank in the English Channel in November 2021. The disaster resulted in the deaths of thirty-one migrants.

Geo-Political.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
Geo-Political.summary: The UK-France "one in, one out" migrant scheme has been canceled after operating for just over a year. During its existence, the program resulted in the removal of approximately 1,500 people to France.

Geo-Political.title: Execution of US murderer Christa Pike halted shortly before it was due to happen
Geo-Political.summary: The execution of Christa Pike, who was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer, was halted shortly before it was scheduled to take place. The stay of execution prevents the carrying out of her death sentence for the time being.

Geo-Political.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight, Russia launched its largest attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure since the spring, targeting 11 regions. The strikes also hit residential buildings and railways, according to the Ukrainian Prime Minister.

Geo-Political.title: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends
Geo-Political.summary: The final UK and US troops have withdrawn from Iraq as the anti-Islamic State mission concludes. This departure fulfills a key demand made by the Iraqi government under an agreement reached two years ago.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress SaaS course. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising.

Data & Insights.title: Weak monsoon unlikely to dent rural demand, Crisil says; Diamond, specialty chemicals, polyester textiles face war risks
Data & Insights.summary: Crisil reports that a potential RBI rate hike and weak monsoon rains will have minimal impact on corporate credit quality and rural demand in India. However, ongoing geopolitical conflicts pose risks to industries such as diamonds, specialty chemicals, and polyester textiles.

Data & Insights.title: Govt keeps small savings rates unchanged for December quarter
Data & Insights.summary: The government has kept interest rates on twelve small savings schemes unchanged for the eleventh consecutive quarter. This decision relies on steady collections to help fund the fiscal deficit despite rising bond yields.

Data & Insights.title: India's fiscal deficit widens to  ₹7.1 lakh crore, hits 41.9% of FY27 target by August
Data & Insights.summary: India's fiscal deficit widened to ₹7.1 lakh crore by August, reaching 41.9% of the government's full-year target for FY27. This is higher than the 38.1% recorded during the same period in the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: Indian economy fares better in August but renewed worries linger
Data & Insights.summary: India's economy improved in August due to increased vehicle sales, credit growth, a stronger rupee, and a reduced trade deficit. However, new geopolitical risks threaten to slow this economic momentum.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China plans to purchase 10 million tonnes of US coal as part of a trade deal with Washington. This agreement provides American miners with a new export market while allowing Beijing to offer strategic concessions in broader trade negotiations.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon wants fewer trade barriers with Europe. But there’s a catch
Data & Insights.summary: PMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon supports reducing trade barriers between the U.S. and Europe. However, he stated that the European Union must first reform its economy, defense, and energy sectors.

India.title: Meghalaya Deputy Chief Minister Backs Review of Foreign Funding Bill
India.summary: Meghalaya Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong supports reviewing a foreign funding bill. He stated that the concerns raised by NGOs and Christian organisations should be addressed during the scrutiny process.

India.title: BJP Kerala Headquarters Attacked, Party Calls For Statewide Agitation
India.summary: The Kerala headquarters of the BJP was attacked under the cover of darkness. In response to the incident, the party has called for a statewide agitation.

India.title: Drug-Free Punjab By 2029-End: Amit Shah's Big Promise Ahead Of Polls
India.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah promised to make Punjab drug-free by the end of 2029 during a BJP rally in Jalandhar. Concluding the "Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra," he appealed to the state's youth to vote for the BJP.

India.title: 19-Year-Old Student Stabbed To Death Outside College In Bengaluru
India.summary: A 19-year-old first-year B.Com student named Yogesh was stabbed to death outside his college in Nagarabhavi, Bengaluru. Police are investigating the incident to determine the motive and apprehend the attacker.

India.title: Delhi AQI Slips To 'Moderate' As Stubble Burning Reported In 6 States
India.summary: Delhi's Air Quality Index dropped to the "moderate" category following the detection of 114 crop residue-burning events across six states. These farm fires occurred between September 15 and 30, with the highest numbers recorded in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh.

India.title: AAP Takes "Chitta" Swipe at BJP As Amit Shah Holds Rally In Punjab, Congress Slams Them Both
India.summary: Punjab AAP chief Aman Arora criticized the BJP's "Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra" during Amit Shah's rally, highlighting the BJP's past governance with the Shiromani Akali Dal regarding the state's drug issue. Meanwhile, the Congress party also condemned both the BJP and AAP.

General.title: Dame Esther Rantzen: A presenter who campaigned for change
General.summary: Dame Esther Rantzen is a veteran broadcaster known for conducting street interviews, leading national campaigns, and hosting emotional reunions. Her extensive television career combined entertainment with advocacy for social change.

General.title: UK believes Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident, PM says
General.summary: The UK prime minister stated that the UK believes Iran was involved in an incident at RAF Fairford. This announcement follows the release of the suspects on strict bail conditions a few days prior.

General.title: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
General.summary: A UK-France migrant removal scheme that began just over a year ago has been scrapped. Under this program, approximately 1,500 people were removed to France.

General.title: Teens who died in car that entered River Wear named
General.summary: Jackson Duke, Luke Etheridge, and Zara Shaw died when their car entered the River Wear. Authorities have identified the three deceased teenagers involved in the fatal incident.

General.title: Brexit referendum 'possible' in Labour election manifesto, Burnham tells BBC
General.summary: Labour's Andy Burnham stated that a Brexit referendum could be included in the party's next election manifesto. Meanwhile, the Prime Minister believes a referendum is inappropriate at this time, though the UK must evaluate its future options.
